from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """A single judgment document's metadata relevant to case cause classification."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title or heading of the judgment document")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The specific legal cause of action or case cause mentioned in the document")
    case_category: str | None = Field(description="The broad legal category of the case (e.g., Administrative, Criminal, Civil)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
